## Where Equations Meet Narrative


Daria is a rare convergence of scientific rigour and literary imagination — a physicist with a PhD who writes books, commands stages, and hosts conversations that make the universe feel personal. Across three distinct channels, one coherent intellectual world unfolds.

The Story

## Between the Laboratoryand the Page


There is a rare kind of mind that moves freely between the precision of a physics equation and the open horizon of a literary sentence — that finds in both the same hunger for truth. Daria's work lives in that threshold: where rigorous doctoral research meets the craft of narrative, where a whiteboard full of formulas gives way to a page full of wonder. Her books, lectures, and podcast are not translations of science into simpler terms — they are original acts of imagination that treat the audience as fellow explorers.








### Research Depth


A PhD in physics grounds every idea in verifiable reality — no metaphor is deployed without the weight of evidence behind it.










### Clarity of Expression


As an author, Daria has cultivated a voice that renders the invisible visible — transforming complex phenomena into language that resonates and endures.










### Public Engagement


From lecture halls to podcast studios, Daria meets audiences where curiosity lives — across formats, platforms, and the full spectrum of human wonder.













Dr. Daria
Physicist · Author · Speaker · Podcast Host

About Daria


# Physicist.Author.Storyteller.


Daria holds a PhD in physics and has spent her career dismantling the wall between the laboratory and the library. She is the author of acclaimed works that translate the mathematics of the universe into language that moves, provokes, and inspires — reaching readers who never thought science could speak to them.


As a public speaker and podcast host, she brings the same precision and wonder to live audiences and audio listeners worldwide, turning complexity into compelling public thought. Her work sits at the rare intersection where rigorous science meets genuine literary craft.



PhD Physicist
Author
Public Speaker
Podcast Host



Explore Her Books
Listen to the Podcast













Ph.D. Physics & Literature






















A Life in Motion


## Milestones & Chapters


From quantum equations to published pages — a chronology of curiosity, scholarship, and public voice.











2008

### BSc in Physics


Graduated with honours in theoretical physics, igniting a lifelong passion for the mathematical language of the universe and its power to explain the invisible.

Academia














2013

### PhD in Theoretical Physics


Completed doctoral research exploring quantum field dynamics. The dissertation bridged rigorous scientific inquiry and a growing desire to communicate complex ideas beyond the laboratory.

Research






2015

### First Book Published


Debut publication blending narrative science writing with personal reflection — an exploration of how physics shapes our understanding of time, memory, and human experience.

Literature














2017

### TEDx Talk — Science as Story


Delivered a widely-shared TEDx lecture on the narrative structures hidden within scientific discovery, reaching audiences far beyond the academic world and establishing a distinct public voice.

Speaking






2019

### Podcast Launch — Parallel Worlds


Founded and hosted Parallel Worlds, an audio series where physics meets philosophy, literature, and lived experience. Within its first season, the show attracted a global community of curious minds.

Podcast














2021

### Second Book & International Tour


Published a second acclaimed work and embarked on an international speaking tour, bringing the intersection of science and storytelling to stages across Europe and the Middle East.

Literature · Speaking






2023

### Digital Content & Thought Leadership


Expanded into digital education, launching original video content, masterclasses, and collaborative essays that position Daria as a leading intellectual voice at the crossroads of science, culture, and creativity.

Digital · Education




























## What I Stand For


These are not abstract principles. They are the live wires running through every lecture, every page, every episode — the commitments that shape how I think, create, and connect.









01


### Intellectual Rigor


Precision is not the enemy of wonder — it is its foundation. Every claim I make is grounded in evidence, every metaphor tested against the physics it represents. I believe that the most honest thing a scientist can do is resist the comfortable shortcut, sit with complexity, and still find a way to make it sing. Rigor is not coldness. It is the deepest form of respect for the audience.

Science · Integrity · Depth











02


### Narrative Accessibility


A PhD should not be a barrier — it should be a bridge. I write and speak to close the gap between the laboratory and the living room, translating equations into emotions without losing the truth inside them. Great science storytelling is an act of radical generosity.

Storytelling · Clarity · Empathy







03


### Interdisciplinary Curiosity


The most interesting questions live at the borders — between physics and philosophy, between a novel and a research paper, between a podcast studio and a lecture hall. I refuse to stay in one lane. Curiosity is not a distraction; it is the method.

Exploration · Connection · Wonder






















## Expertise & Presence


At the intersection of theoretical physics and literary craft, Daria has built a rare intellectual platform — spanning peer-reviewed research, authored books, live speaking stages, and an audio series that makes the universe feel intimate. Here is where the credentials meet the calling.








Academic & Research







### PhD in Theoretical Physics

Dissertation: Quantum Field Symmetry & Emergent Complexity

Doctoral research at the frontier of quantum mechanics and emergent phenomena, exploring how complex order arises from fundamental physical laws.











### University Lecturer

Physics & Science Communication · Ongoing

Teaching undergraduate and graduate courses in physics, with a focus on bridging rigorous scientific thinking and accessible public understanding.











### Published Author

3 Books · Science & Literary Fiction

Author of works that traverse the boundary between scientific inquiry and narrative imagination — including a novel shortlisted for a national literary prize and a popular science title praised for its clarity and depth.











### Peer-Reviewed Research

12+ Publications · International Journals

Contributions to journals in theoretical physics and science communication, with citations across academic and popular science communities.







Public Voice & Media







### Podcast Host — Signal & Noise

80+ Episodes · Science, Culture & Ideas

A long-running audio series that invites scientists, writers, and thinkers to explore the hidden patterns connecting the physical world and the human experience. Consistently ranked among top science podcasts.











### Public Speaker

TEDx · Science Festivals · Literary Conferences

Keynote addresses and invited talks at major science communication festivals, literary events, and academic symposia — translating complex physics into stories audiences carry home with them.











### Media & Press Features

National & International Coverage

Featured in science magazines, literary supplements, and broadcast media as a leading voice on science communication, women in STEM, and the art of making ideas accessible to wide audiences.











### Digital Content Creator

Science & Culture · Multi-Platform

An active digital presence spanning long-form essays, social science storytelling, and curated reading lists — building a community around intellectual curiosity and the joy of discovery.

The Writing Process



## Where EquationsBecome Stories


Every book begins the same way a physics paper does — with a question that refuses to leave you alone. The process of translating rigorous science into language that breathes and resonates is itself a kind of discovery.




01


### Deep Research


Each project starts in the laboratory of ideas — journals, field notes, conversations with colleagues, and years of accumulated scientific intuition. No shortcut replaces genuine expertise at the source material.





02


### Translating Complexity


The hardest editorial challenge is preserving the truth of a concept while stripping away the jargon that hides it. Analogies, narrative arcs, and carefully chosen metaphors become the bridge between the equation and the reader.





03


### Voice Development


A voice that holds both scientific precision and literary warmth is rare. It is built through thousands of hours of reading, writing, lecturing, and listening — shaped equally by the physics seminar and the novelist's craft.





04


### Audience Connection


Science becomes culture when readers feel invited rather than tested. Every chapter is calibrated for the curious non-specialist — someone who wants to understand the universe, not just memorise its formulas.






Discuss a Collaboration








Draft — Chapter III
v.2.4


"The wave function does not collapse — it simply chooses, in the moment of observation, which story to tell. And every story, even the ones we call equations, is an act of imagination constrained by truth..."



Revise metaphor — check Bohr correspondence





Research Note

"The structure of a chapter mirrors the structure of a wave."







The writing studio, Tel Aviv

## Where Science Meets the Spoken Word


Daria holds a PhD in physics and has spent years translating the universe's most intricate ideas into language anyone can feel. As a lecturer, she doesn't simply present information — she builds a narrative arc that moves from curiosity to revelation.


Her talks draw on her dual identity as a scientist and a published author, weaving research, personal story, and literary craft into a singular experience. From academic symposia to TEDx stages, from literary festivals to media conversations — Daria arrives prepared to challenge, inspire, and connect.


- The Physics of Creativity & Imagination

- Science, Story & the Art of Explanation

- Women in Science & Intellectual Courage

- The Universe as a Literary Text

Speaking Formats


## Bringing Science & Storyto Every Stage


From intimate academic seminars to large public stages, Daria offers a range of speaking formats that bridge rigorous scientific thinking and the art of narrative. Each engagement is crafted to leave audiences with a new lens on the world.














Keynote Talk

### The Physics of Wonder


A signature keynote that weaves quantum mechanics, cosmology, and the human impulse to tell stories into a single cohesive arc. Designed for conferences, festivals, and institutional events where ideas must resonate far beyond the room.


- Duration45 – 75 min

- AudienceGeneral public & professionals














Academic–Public Crossover

### Lecture Series


Structured lectures designed to sit at the intersection of peer-level scientific discourse and public accessibility. Ideal for universities, research institutions, and cultural organisations seeking depth without sacrificing clarity.

Moderated Conversation

### In Dialogue


An intimate, live conversation format where Daria joins a moderator or fellow thinker to explore the edges of science, creativity, and meaning-making. Suited for literary festivals, podcasts recorded live, and curated salon evenings.


- Duration40 – 60 min

- AudienceIntimate & festival formats














Workshop

### Storytelling in Science


A hands-on workshop for researchers, science communicators, and educators exploring how narrative structure, character, and metaphor can transform complex scientific ideas into compelling public communication — without sacrificing accuracy.


- DurationHalf or full day

- AudienceResearchers & educators

Signature Topics


## What Daria Speaks About


Each lecture is a journey through ideas — from the equations that govern galaxies to the sentences that move hearts. These are the themes that define her work on stage, on the page, and in the air.







- 01 ### The Poetry of Physics What happens when a physicist reads a poem — and a poet reads an equation? This lecture explores the unexpected kinship between scientific language and literary form: the rhythm of a formula, the metaphor hidden in a theorem, the beauty of describing the universe in the fewest possible words. Daria draws on her dual life as a physicist and author to reveal that precision and poetry are not opposites — they are collaborators. Science & Language


- ### Storytelling and Truth Science advances through evidence; literature advances through empathy. But both are, at their core, acts of storytelling. This talk examines how narrative structure shapes the way we understand facts, how stories can illuminate or distort reality, and why the craft of telling a true story is one of the most demanding — and important — skills of our time. A meditation on honesty, imagination, and the ethics of explanation. Narrative & Epistemology 02


- 03 ### Science in Public Culture At a moment when scientific consensus is contested in public squares and social feeds, how does science communicate itself to the world? Daria examines the gap between the laboratory and the living room — how institutions, media, and individual scientists shape (and misshape) public understanding. Drawing on her experience as a podcast host and public intellectual, she offers a frank, nuanced account of what it means to be a scientist in the age of viral misinformation. Public Discourse


- ### Curiosity as a Civic Practice Curiosity is not merely a personality trait — it is a democratic virtue. This lecture makes the case that asking questions, tolerating uncertainty, and remaining genuinely open to being wrong are not just scientific habits but essential civic ones. Daria argues that the disposition of the scientist — humble, rigorous, endlessly curious — is exactly what public life needs more of, and explores how we might cultivate it across education, media, and community. Education & Democracy 04


- 05 ### The Craft of Explaining the Invisible Dark matter. Quantum entanglement. The structure of spacetime. How do you explain something that cannot be seen, touched, or directly experienced? This masterclass in scientific communication unpacks the tools — analogy, rhythm, image, silence — that make the abstract tangible. Whether you are a researcher, a teacher, a journalist, or simply someone who has ever struggled to explain a complex idea, this talk offers a practical and philosophical guide to making the invisible felt. Science Communication

## Science Told Like a Story


For curious minds who crave depth without intimidation — where physics meets narrative, and every episode opens a new dimension of understanding.








### Clarity Without Compromise


Complex ideas from quantum mechanics to cosmology, distilled through the lens of a physicist who also writes fiction. No jargon. No condescension. Just ideas made luminous.











### Imagination as a Scientific Tool


Daria bridges the worlds of literature and laboratory — showing how creative thinking and scientific rigor are not opposites, but partners in every great discovery.











### Depth That Stays With You


Each episode is crafted with the precision of a PhD thesis and the warmth of a campfire story — designed for science enthusiasts, aspiring writers, and educational podcasters who want substance, not surface.

Media Kit


## Collaborate with Daria


Physicist. Author. Podcast Host. Public Speaker. A rare intellectual voice where science meets storytelling.


Daria brings a PhD in physics, a published author's craft, and years of public speaking experience to every collaboration. Whether you're programming a science festival, curating a literary event, or producing a podcast series, Daria offers a perspective that is both rigorously scientific and deeply human — making complex ideas not just accessible, but genuinely captivating for broad audiences.














### Guest Appearances


Daria is available as a guest speaker for podcasts, radio programs, academic panels, and science communication events. She speaks fluently across topics including quantum physics, the intersection of science and literature, women in STEM, and the art of making complexity beautiful.


- Podcast guest interviews (30–90 min)

- Festival keynotes & panel discussions

- University & institutional lectures

- Live science storytelling events













### Interview Themes


Every conversation with Daria moves between the precise and the poetic. Her dual identity as a scientist and storyteller opens rich territory for interviewers across disciplines — from hard science to cultural commentary to creative process.


- Physics, cosmology & quantum theory

- Writing at the edge of science & fiction

- Science communication & public education

- Creative process & intellectual curiosity













### Partnership Opportunities


Daria is open to long-form creative and institutional partnerships — from co-produced podcast series to branded educational content. Collaborations are evaluated on alignment with her mission: making science and ideas genuinely exciting for curious minds everywhere.


- Co-produced podcast series & seasons

- Educational content & digital campaigns

- Science festival & literary event curation

- Brand alignment & media sponsorships

### What I'm Available For


I welcome inquiries across a range of professional engagements — from scientific lectures to literary collaborations and media appearances.


- #### Lectures & Keynotes Public talks on physics, science communication, and the intersection of science and storytelling.

- #### Podcast & Media Interviews Guest appearances, podcast collaborations, and media features discussing science, books, and ideas.

- #### Writing & Editorial Commissioned essays, forewords, science writing for publications, and editorial collaborations.

- #### Creative Collaborations Cross-disciplinary projects bridging science and art, digital content partnerships, and educational initiatives.






























## Frequently Asked Questions


Everything you need to know before reaching out








01



### What kinds of inquiries do you respond to?


I respond to requests related to speaking engagements, media appearances, podcast collaborations, book club partnerships, and educational consulting. I also welcome thoughtful messages from readers and listeners — though personal replies may take a little longer.






02



### What collaboration categories are available?


Collaborations span three main areas: science communication and educational content creation, literary and narrative projects, and audio storytelling or podcast guest features. Each project is considered individually to ensure it aligns with Daria's creative and intellectual vision.






03



### What event formats does Daria participate in?


Available formats include keynote lectures, university seminars, literary festival panels, corporate innovation talks, workshop series, and online live sessions. Both in-person and remote formats are accommodated — please specify your preference and location when reaching out.

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  5/10/2026



Daria ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: Daria

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  May 10, 2026



Daria is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Daria

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.
